incidents.name: Sentiment Balancer LP oracle read-only reentrancy
incidents.notes: The victim's own accounting was sound; WeightedBalancerLPOracle.getPrice() read the Balancer vault's token balances and BPT supply without the vault's reentrancy check, so exiting a pool inside the ETH-transfer callback let the attacker have the collateral BPT priced at an inflated value and borrow against it.

sources.ref: onchain review: oracle 0x16f3ae9c1727ee38c98417ca08ba785bb7641b5b created 2022-11-14 by 0xc5fc2cbf32c09f89f91caf2023884729116ea5d1 (Sentiment deployer), unrelated to attack sender 0xdd0cdb4c3b887bc533957bc32463977e432e49c3; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, so the code was ~141 days old; classified oracle-manipulation per the dataset precedent that price-skewing (read-only) reentrancy is an oracle failure rather than a state-changing code bug
